title: Give every WMBT entry an id, a statement and its proving artifacts

facts.note: Task text mentions WMBTs or decomposing a wagon (authoring, reviewing or validating them).
Planning artifact that holds a wagon decomposition / WMBT entries; touching or reading it for review puts its entries in scope.
Diff-level observer that detects any WMBT entry being added or edited (any field) in a wagon decomposition.
Whether the planner is inspecting/validating existing WMBT entries without editing them is judged from the task.

fires: Planner adds a new WMBT entry to a wagon decomposition.
Planner edits any field of an existing WMBT entry.
Planner inspects, reviews or validates existing WMBT entries in a wagon decomposition, even without editing them.
Planner restructures or regenerates a wagon decomposition that contains WMBT entries.
doesNotFire: Work that neither authors, inspects nor validates WMBT entries (e.g. editing unrelated planning docs).
Implementing code or tests for an already-shaped WMBT (coder work, not planning).

given: A wagon decomposition containing What-Must-Be-True (WMBT) entries that you are authoring, editing, inspecting or validating.
when: You add, edit, review or validate any WMBT entry.
then: Every WMBT entry declares its id, its statement, and the proving artifacts (the acceptances/tests that prove the statement).
prefer: Write the id, the statement and the list of proving acceptances/tests together when the entry is created.
When reviewing existing entries, flag or complete any entry lacking id, statement or proving artifacts.
avoid: A WMBT entry missing its id, its statement, or its proving artifacts.
Listing proving artifacts that do not actually prove the entry's statement.
why: Downstream planning (per-WMBT acceptance coverage, feature grouping, smoke acceptances) operates over enumerated, well-shaped WMBTs; an entry without id, statement or proof cannot be referenced or verified.
evidence: Each WMBT entry in the wagon decomposition has a non-empty id, a non-empty statement and at least one referenced proving artifact (acceptance/test).
Severity 2, disposition documentation-only: reviewed by reading the decomposition; no automated detector is preserved.
verifier_detail: Terms: wmbt_entry = a What-Must-Be-True entry in a wagon decomposition; proving_artifacts = the acceptances/tests that prove the WMBT statement.
Disposition documentation-only, severity 2: no detector implementation preserved (parity.implementation_preserved=false).
